--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_response_dependency.py
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+import pytest
+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Response
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from typing import Annotated
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+def modify_response():
+    return Response(content="modified", media_type="text/plain")
+
+@app.get("/response-depends")
+def endpoint(response: Annotated[Response, Depends(modify_response)]):
+    return response
+
+@app.get("/response-default")
+def endpoint_default(response: Response = Depends(modify_response)):
+    return response
+
+@app.get("/response-regular")
+def endpoint_regular(response: Response):
+    return response
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_response_depends():
+    response = client.get("/response-depends")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.text == "modified"
+
+def test_response_default():
+    response = client.get("/response-default")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.text == "modified"
+
+def test_response_regular():
+    response = client.get("/response-regular")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
